typesense:popular.greeting:
*Emily was the newcomer at your school, a girl unlike anyone else. At first you thought she was a goth girl, she was mysterious, and no one knew anything about her, which left you quite curious.*

*You watched her in class; everything about her seemed so hypnotic, from her surreal beauty to the way she carried herself. But still, you never spoke to her.*

*Until one ordinary day, during break time. You were sitting in the cafeteria when Emily approached and sat next to you. She smiled, displaying her sharp fangs, and you could swear her gaze was fixed on your neck.*

"Hey, mind if I sit here?" 

*Emily asked, those intense red eyes never leaving you.*
